tokens.name: bg-table
tokens.usage: The felt. Page background of every menu screen.

tokens.name: bg-table-deep
tokens.usage: Edges and vignette of the felt, and the scrim behind modals.

tokens.name: surface-panel
tokens.usage: Cream panels: modals, game cards, shop items, settings groups.

tokens.name: surface-panel-inset
tokens.usage: Wells inside a cream panel: claimed reward tile, code chip ground, divider lines.

tokens.name: surface-night
tokens.usage: The one dark feature card (shop) and pills in the top bar.

tokens.name: action-primary
tokens.usage: Flat red for small marks that are not buttons: badges, ribbons, today's reward tile. Buttons use the primary gradient stops.

tokens.name: action-primary-pressed
tokens.usage: Darker flat red, kept for pressed marks and the default card back.

tokens.name: action-primary-deep
tokens.usage: The modal frame and the lip under today's reward tile.

tokens.name: action-confirm
tokens.usage: Flat green for state marks: switch track when on, upcoming reward tiles, the check mark, owned-item text. Buttons use the confirm gradient stops.

tokens.name: action-confirm-deep
tokens.usage: Darker flat green, kept for pressed marks.

tokens.name: action-neutral
tokens.usage: Flat grey-brown for the switch track when off. Buttons use the neutral gradient stops.

tokens.name: action-neutral-deep
tokens.usage: Darker flat grey-brown.

tokens.name: primary-top
tokens.usage: Top stop of the red button gradient. Exact value from the Yanık Masası build.

tokens.name: primary-mid
tokens.usage: Middle stop (55%) of the red button gradient; the label sits on this.

tokens.name: primary-bottom
tokens.usage: Bottom stop of the red button gradient.

tokens.name: primary-lip
tokens.usage: Lip under red buttons.

tokens.name: confirm-top
tokens.usage: Top stop of the green button gradient.

tokens.name: confirm-mid
tokens.usage: Middle stop of the green button gradient; the label sits on this.

tokens.name: confirm-bottom
tokens.usage: Bottom stop of the green button gradient.

tokens.name: confirm-lip
tokens.usage: Lip under green buttons.

tokens.name: secondary-top
tokens.usage: Top stop of the gold secondary button gradient.

tokens.name: secondary-mid
tokens.usage: Middle stop of the gold secondary button gradient; the label sits on this.

tokens.name: secondary-bottom
tokens.usage: Bottom stop of the gold secondary button gradient.

tokens.name: secondary-lip
tokens.usage: Lip under gold secondary buttons.

tokens.name: text-on-secondary
tokens.usage: Label color on the gold secondary button.

tokens.name: alt-top
tokens.usage: Top stop of the muted blue alternative button gradient.

tokens.name: alt-mid
tokens.usage: Middle stop of the muted blue alternative button; the label sits on this.

tokens.name: alt-bottom
tokens.usage: Bottom stop of the muted blue alternative button gradient.

tokens.name: alt-lip
tokens.usage: Lip under muted blue alternative buttons.

tokens.name: neutral-top
tokens.usage: Top stop of the grey-brown gradient. Only for things that are off or not selected: unselected tabs. Not a button color for actions.

tokens.name: neutral-mid
tokens.usage: Middle stop of the grey-brown gradient for unselected tabs.

tokens.name: neutral-bottom
tokens.usage: Bottom stop of the grey-brown gradient for unselected tabs.

tokens.name: neutral-lip
tokens.usage: Lip color paired with the grey-brown gradient.

tokens.name: locked-top
tokens.usage: Top stop of a locked or disabled button. Source value; cream text near the top edge is below 4.5:1, kept as the build has it.

tokens.name: locked-mid
tokens.usage: Middle stop of a locked or disabled button.

tokens.name: locked-bottom
tokens.usage: Bottom stop of a locked or disabled button.

tokens.name: locked-lip
tokens.usage: Lip under a locked or disabled button.

tokens.name: play-glow
tokens.usage: Soft amber glow around the play banner only.

tokens.name: trim-gold
tokens.usage: Borders on buttons, panels and pills. Decorative only, never text on cream.

tokens.name: trim-gold-deep
tokens.usage: Coin rim and pressed gold borders.

tokens.name: trim-gold-light
tokens.usage: Gold text on surface-night and bg-table: shop title, level label.

tokens.name: coin
tokens.usage: Coin face and the notification of a waiting reward. Not a text color.

tokens.name: status-online
tokens.usage: The live dot next to an online player count on action-primary and bg-table. A mark, not a text color.

tokens.name: text-on-dark
tokens.usage: Text on bg-table, surface-night and every filled button.

tokens.name: text-on-dark-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on bg-table: level, online count, nav labels.

tokens.name: text-on-panel
tokens.usage: Body text on surface-panel and surface-panel-inset.

tokens.name: text-on-panel-muted
tokens.usage: Helper text on surface-panel: setting descriptions, units.

tokens.name: text-heading
tokens.usage: Headings and setting names on surface-panel; the diamond divider.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus outline, 3px solid with 2px offset. Holds 3:1 on felt, cream and night.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Screen titles, modal titles, game card titles. Uppercase.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Group headings inside panels and shop item names. Uppercase.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Sentences: modal copy, setting names. Sentence case.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Helper text, units, nav labels. Sentence case.

styles.name: numeric
styles.usage: Coin amounts and prices. Tabular figures, Turkish thousands dot.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between an icon and its label; coin and amount.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between sibling controls; padding inside pills.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Vertical padding in rows; gap between tiles.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen gutter on phones; panel padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between panels; modal padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between screen sections.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Small tiles, code chip, tabs.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons and reward tiles.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Panels, modals, shop items.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Lobby game cards.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Currency pills, switches, badges, the level bar.

tokens.name: shadow-panel
tokens.usage: Modals and anything that floats above the felt.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Resting panels and game cards sitting on the felt.
